facts.text: Montage Big Sky is located 45 minutes from Yellowstone National Park.
facts.excerpt: Spanish Peaks mountain range and located 45 minutes from Yellowstone National Park, Montage Big Sky resort offers ski-in / ski-out access.

facts.text: Montage Big Sky offers ski-in/ski-out access.
facts.excerpt: Spanish Peaks mountain range and located 45 minutes from Yellowstone National Park, Montage Big Sky resort offers ski-in / ski-out access.

facts.text: Guestrooms, suites and residences are set across three settings: The Lodge, Inn and Mountain Homes.
facts.excerpt: thoughtfully situated across three distinct settings– The Lodge, Inn and Mountain Homes– providing a contemporary mountainside retreat.

facts.text: The resort's design palette uses locally sourced woods and stones.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by a timeless Montana-inspired palette of locally sourced woods and stones

facts.text: Spa Montage offers signature Elements of Wellness treatments and an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy signature Elements of Wellness treatments, an indoor pool and refined amenities at Spa Montage

facts.text: The resort has five dining outlets, including wood-fired Italian cuisine and fresh-caught fish.
facts.excerpt: five unique dining outlets, offering exquisite wood-fired Italian cuisine, fresh-caught fish

facts.text: The resort was developed in partnership with Lone Mountain Land Company and is Montage's second mountain property, after Deer Valley.
facts.excerpt: Developed in partnership with Lone Mountain Land Company, the $400 million resort is the second mountain property from the Montage brand (Deer Valley was the first).

facts.text: Cortina serves Northern Italian dishes such as braised ossobuco and paccheri Bolognese topped with white truffle.
facts.excerpt: Cortina transports guests to Northern Italy with dishes such as braised ossobuco and paccheri Bolognese topped with white truffle

facts.text: Wildflower Market serves coffee, breakfast burritos and house-made pastries, plus grab-and-go sandwiches and salads.
facts.excerpt: Wildflower Market, which serves coffee, breakfast burritos and house-made pastries, as well as grab-and-go sandwiches and salad

facts.text: The spa offers facials with Valmont and Arcona products, sound healing, and massages that help guests acclimate to the altitude.
facts.excerpt: facials utilizing products from lauded Swiss brand Valmont and L.A.-based Arcona, and innovative therapies like sound healing and massages that help guests acclimate to the altitude

facts.text: The resort sits within the Spanish Peaks enclave, about a 20-minute drive from the Big Sky Resort base area and main town.
facts.excerpt: Located within the 3,530-acre Spanish Peaks enclave, the resort is about a 20-minute drive from the Big Sky Resort base area and main town.

facts.text: A complimentary Cadillac program helps guests get around.
facts.excerpt: A complimentary Cadillac program makes it a breeze to get around.

facts.text: The resort is about five turns from the Lewis & Clark lift, which accesses beginner-friendly terrain.
facts.excerpt: The ski-in/ski-out location is about five turns to the Lewis & Clark lift, which accesses beginner-friendly terrain

facts.text: In winter, an ice skating rink, tubing hill and designated beginner ski area are steps from the hotel door.
facts.excerpt: In winter, an ice skating rink, tubing hill, and designated beginner’s ski area are steps from the hotel door

facts.text: Beartooth Pub and Rec has arcade games and an adjacent bowling alley.
facts.excerpt: wood-fired pizzas, ice cream sundaes, and craft beers, plus arcade games and an adjacent bowling alley

facts.text: It is the first Montage property that is 100% plastic-free.
facts.excerpt: This is the first Montage property that’s 100% plastic-free.

facts.text: The on-site activity center, Compass Sports, sells lift tickets and arranges ski lockers, rentals, boot fittings, lessons and guides in winter.
facts.excerpt: In winter, you can purchase lift tickets directly at the shop and the team arranges ski lockers, rentals, boot fittings, and lessons and guides.

facts.text: In summer, golfers can play the private 18-hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf.
facts.excerpt: golfers can play the private 18-hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf

facts.text: The hotel's art collection is all from Montana artists.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s art collection—all from Montana artists—is museum-worthy

facts.text: Winter activities include guided snowshoe treks with a naturalist and Nordic skiing.
facts.excerpt: from guided snowshoe treks with a naturalist to Nordic skiing and snowshoeing

facts.text: The resort offers a private full-day guided Yellowstone fly fishing experience.
facts.excerpt: Private Full Day Yellowstone Fly Fishing
